unit.note: Full shared/tests suite (8663 passed, 32 skipped, 20 deselected) run fresh against the current code state after all review-cascade fixes. Targeted new/changed test files also re-run individually throughout: test_decision_log_index*.py, test_decision_drops_index*.py, test_write_decision_log*.py, test_aggregate_decisions.py, test_write_decision_drop.py, test_adr_index_churn_integration.py. e2e.reason: no browser/HTTP/CLI-user-facing surface of its own — pure Python library/CLI/doc change

smoke.reason: no startable server surface in this repo

behaviors.behavior: `render_decision_log_index` parses `### ADR-NNN: Title` headings, fence-aware
Bare heading with no title still renders
`current-status` derived from `(supersedes ADR-NNN)` marker
Supersedes match is case-insensitive
Title brackets escaped so link label isn't truncated
GitHub-heading-anchor slugify matches expected shape
Missing `decision_log.md` → strict no-op
Write is atomic (failed replace leaves prior index intact)
Written index is LF-only even on Windows
CLI regenerates against a real folder
`append_decision()` (direct path) refreshes the index in the same call
Index refresh at append is best-effort and warns, not raises
`aggregate_decisions.py` refreshes with zero drops (fixes the fold-only-refresh defect)
`aggregate_decisions.py` dry-run writes nothing
Committed `decision_log_index.md` in THIS repo is not stale (drift guard)
Drift guard actually fails on a stale index (guard is provably not vacuous)
Every real decision-log entry (fence-aware) is listed in the committed index
`DECISION_LOG_INDEX` is registered as resolvable churn
`DECISION_LOG_INDEX` is not a `DERIVED_SNAPSHOTS` member
Two-diverged-branch real merge refreshes+stages the index end-to-end (`cross_component` integration)
A failed post-merge refresh is reported in `steps`, not swallowed
Decision-drops index: no pending drops renders the empty state
A pending drop is listed with its title
Missing title falls back to a decision snippet
Scaffolding files (`.gitkeep`, `_*.json`) are skipped
A malformed drop is skipped, not fatal to the whole render
Missing drops dir → strict no-op
Drops-index write is atomic
Drops-index CLI regenerates against a real folder
`write_decision_drop.py`'s CLI refreshes the drops index
Drops-index refresh at write is best-effort and warns
`aggregate_decisions.py` folding a drop refreshes the drops index back to empty
The drops index carries no `CHURN_ALLOWLIST` entry (deliberate, asserted not just narrated)
`docs/hooks-and-pipeline.md` churn table stays in sync both directions
behaviors.evidence: `test_churn_merge_doc_sync.py::test_doc_table_matches_churn_allowlist_both_directions` PASSED (pre-existing test, re-run green after the new entry)

behaviors.behavior: Full pre-existing ADR-index + decision-log/drop suite has zero regressions
Supersedes marker matches an unpadded reference (`ADR-42`) against a zero-padded heading (`ADR-042`)
A multi-target marker (`supersedes ADR-042 and ADR-100`) annotates every target
Supersedes marker need not be the last thing in the title
`refresh_best_effort` warns (not raises) on an undecodable `decision_log.md`
Decision-drops index lock is anchored at the resolved drops-dir's own root, not the caller's `project_root` (two worktrees contend on the SAME lock file)
An embedded newline in a drop's title cannot break its bullet row
A mid-loop exception in `aggregate()`'s per-drop architecture-doc step still refreshes the index (via `finally`), not just a clean pass
`write_decision_log.py`'s CLI runs with no `PYTHONPATH` set (the invocation shape plan/build/deploy actually use)
behaviors.evidence: `test_write_decision_log_bootstrap.py::test_cli_runs_with_no_pythonpath_set` PASSED (split out of `test_write_decision_log.py` — bloat-gate crossing at 301 lines)

behaviors.behavior: A `### DR-NNN` entry (shipwright-design's own numbering, sharing the log with ADR-NNN) is indexed alongside ADR entries
A DR-NNN and an ADR-NNN sharing digits never collide through the supersession lookup
`(supersedes ADR-042, see ADR-100)` annotates only the named target, not every ADR the trailing text happens to mention
A `null` (or non-string) `decision` field in a drop does not crash the title fallback
Markdown-active characters in a drop's title cannot become a live link/image or break a code span
An uncommitted local edit to `decision_log.md` at merge time is skipped, not staged as an index describing content no commit contains
A deleted `decision_log.md` post-merge does not falsely report `-refreshed` for an unchanged, stale committed index
`write_decision_log.py` works when imported IN-PROCESS by a test session whose own `lib` package already shadows shared's (ADR-045 collision, distinct from row 43's bare-CLI bootstrap)
behaviors.evidence: `plugins/shipwright-build/tests/test_integration.py::test_setup_and_track_section` + `tests/test_tools.py::test_write_decision_log` + `::test_write_decision_log_creates_dir` — reproduced the CI failure locally before the fix (`load_shared_lib` + relative imports in `decision_log_index.py`/`decision_drops_index.py`), all PASSED after

surface_verification.justification: pure Python library/CLI/doc change with no HTTP, browser, or CLI-user-facing surface of its own — the framework's dev-loop test suite (shared/tests/) is the executable surface, exercised directly via the full-suite run recorded in unit.
